dispute.claim_text: I take Jurong East to MBS almost every Sunday and it is always about 21km and around $27. Today the driver went past the Marina exit, all the way to Rochor and came back. 27km, $35.64. He even admitted in the chat that he missed the exit. Please refund me the difference.

counterparty_statement.text: I took a wrong turn at the MCE exit and had to come back around. Sorry about that.
